# Sampling recommendations in the existing Monitoring application

This component turns an already saved observed context into an editable proposed sampling programme. It retains the exact original observations, station identities, source edition, analytical cohorts, historical period, calendar and network. It uses the maintained Monitoring solver for an explicitly requested future design. It adds no observations and no second solver.

## Operator course

1. Open **Sampling priorities**, choose a saved observed context and inspect its original source period, source station matches and exact analytical cohorts. The source picker exposes the currently retained context; it does not issue a public-data request.
2. Enter the programme title, person recording the proposal, actual recording timestamp and planning rationale. Select an evidence window contained within the source's published period.
3. Add a target with an original station and an exact retained cohort. Choose months, a historical minimum of distinct observation dates per month, and a separate proposed number of future visits. The historical minimum applies across the selected evidence window, not separately to every year. The report exposes the dates and years so the interpretation stays inspectable.
4. Enter any proposed reporting-limit target in the unchanged cohort unit, with its explicit rationale. Unknown original reporting limits and incompatible limit units stay visible. No censored value is replaced with zero, half a limit or a generated concentration.
5. Choose any-flow or high-flow intent. Historical event coverage applies only when the retained source explicitly declares the same station and period as the gauge. Nearby stations do not inherit that flow. Future fixed dates do not guarantee a storm.
6. Enter setup and per-visit costs as exact USD decimal strings, or leave them unknown. Zero is an explicit zero. State the cost source or operator assumption. The proposal sums each included target separately; overlapping visits are not automatically discounted.
7. Preview complete station/month support, original observation IDs and rows, reporting limits, source warnings and the proposed budget. Priority is an operator ranking; it is not calculated information gain. Optional sensitivity context is attributed prose, not an inferred match to an unrelated model.
8. Save the immutable proposal. Editing a saved proposal creates a child edition using its exact native ID; the original remains available. The source context is fixed within one proposal family.
9. To request a native design, supply the complete native configuration and include the selected targets' catchments in its explicit required_ids. Resolve unbound stations and multiple stations assigned to one catchment first. Unknown proposal costs may remain unknown when the native configuration supplies its own complete explicit costs; the two budgets stay separate. Set a future calendar after the historical evidence window, with the actual budget, costs, visit lengths, crews and dates. The unchanged native solver owns feasibility, calendar capacity and geographic objective.
10. Read the returned native plan and each target's actual selected-month visit count. The native design has its own entered budget and cost table, shown separately from the itemized proposal estimate. Laboratory analyte/limit requirements and event-triggered work remain explicit planned scope. Creating a plan creates no collected field event.
11. Export the complete proposal bundle, open its readable report and CSVs, and inspect the exact original source files. For an independently editable receiving application, export the original complete Study/Workspace through the current application and reopen that archive. The report ZIP is not a replacement Workspace.

## Model API

All functions are in model.monitoring_recommendations.

- catalog(workspace): observed-context summaries and saved proposal summaries.
- context(workspace, context_id): exact source/station/cohort catalogue. design_configuration is the original saved plan's unchanged configuration when available, otherwise null.
- preview(workspace, *, selection): compute the full proposal without writing.
- prepare(workspace, *, selection, operation_id, parent_id=None, expected_parent_digest=None): save an immutable proposal. For a successor set both parent_id and expected_parent_digest to the exact native parent.id.
- inspect(workspace, recommendation_id): reopen and compare the complete saved calculation with its retained context.
- list_saved(workspace), history(workspace, recommendation_id), designs(workspace, recommendation_id), inspect_design(workspace, design_id).
- design(workspace, *, recommendation_id, configuration, operation_id, title=None): run the original monitoring_design.solve_design and retain the exact plan/result.
- report_html(record, native_designs=None): complete readable report.
- export_members(workspace, recommendation_id): streamable complete-member descriptors for source/package composition.
- export_recommendations(workspace, *, recommendation_id, export_root=None): original file-ticket-compatible path/bytes/SHA result.
- verify_workspace(workspace): inspect retained proposals and native design/source identities.
- compile_recommendations(record, selection): pure calculation from an already inspected full context; useful to a source-native receiving course.

## Exact selection shape

selection contains context_id, title, operator, recorded_at (ISO timestamp with timezone), evidence_start/evidence_end (YYYY-MM-DD), notes, planning_basis and targets.

Every target has:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| id | Stable explicit target ID, unique within the proposal |
| station_id | Exact source_station_id from the context |
| cohort_id | Exact cohort ID from the context catalogue |
| months | Nonempty distinct integers 1–12 |
| minimum_dates_per_month | Nonnegative historical date-count goal across the selected evidence window |
| proposed_visits | Nonnegative future planning count |
| reporting_limit | Null or nonnegative exact decimal string in the cohort's original unit |
| reporting_limit_basis | Explicit scientific/operator rationale |
| flow_goal | any or high_flow |
| reason | Concrete purpose of the target |
| priority | Operator-entered integer 1–5 |
| included | Boolean; excluded targets remain saved and visible |
| setup_cost / per_visit_cost | Null or exact USD amount string, at most two decimal places |
| cost_basis | Published source or explicit operator planning assumption |
| sensitivity_basis | Optional source-qualified narrative; no automatic information-gain calculation |

Cohort identity retains both field presence and value. Missing, null and empty metadata remain distinct. Characteristic, method, unit, fraction, value type, speciation and available method/media/depth/project metadata participate. Original concentration values and source record IDs do not split a cohort; every original row remains retained.

Output targets preserve their full input under target, the original station match, complete cohort fields, original evidence rows and IDs, monthly gaps, reporting-limit comparisons, exact flow applicability, itemized costs and warnings. The top-level gaps array is the complete monthly table. budget splits known_total_cents from unknown_target_ids. handoff preserves required_catchment_ids, unbound_target_ids, station_binding_conflicts, station_bindings and complete included requirements.

## Native persistence and retries

Immutable collections:

- monitoring_recommendations: source-bound proposal editions and parent ancestry.
- monitoring_recommendation_designs: proposal-to-original-native-plan selections/results.
- monitoring_plans: existing authoritative solver plans.

The small monitoring_recommendation_operations index is operation recovery, not a second scientific store. Exact retries return the original immutable result. Reusing an operation ID for another payload fails. Interrupted publication after an immutable save is recovered by the original operation marker. Native solver plans retain their recommendation operation/fingerprint so a crash before the result index does not repeat the solved design.

The original Workspace _save/_get methods own content addressing. The source context, network and plan are checked through their maintained original readers. No live source, running worker, original observation or old plan is overwritten.

## Native CLI

From the existing application root, use its compatible GIS Python:

    GIS_PYTHON -m model.monitoring_recommendations --workspace WORKSPACE catalog --output catalog.json
    GIS_PYTHON -m model.monitoring_recommendations --workspace WORKSPACE context --request context-request.json --output context.json
    GIS_PYTHON -m model.monitoring_recommendations --workspace WORKSPACE preview --request preview-request.json --output preview.json
    GIS_PYTHON -m model.monitoring_recommendations --workspace WORKSPACE prepare --request prepare-request.json --output saved.json
    GIS_PYTHON -m model.monitoring_recommendations --workspace WORKSPACE design --request design-request.json --output design.json
    GIS_PYTHON -m model.monitoring_recommendations --workspace WORKSPACE export --request export-request.json --output export.json

Request JSON uses the same named keyword arguments as the functions. The existing queued operator injects its actual task ID as operation_id. It preserves one operation across response loss and reload.

## Complete producing and receiving course

Use one actual retained context in the original received application; prefer the physically received Eighteenmile source cohort where already admitted. Do not manufacture an observed source to make the screen populated. If the source has not yet been bound to a saved network, use the existing context intake and exact original station mapping first.

Create an explicitly authored proposal using those real rows. Inspect one fully observed station/cohort and one month with no retained match; choose costs and goals as visibly authored planning assumptions. Save it, change a target, save a child edition and reopen both. Repeat the identical save operation and confirm the same immutable ID; a different payload under that operation must not create a new proposal.

Request a native design using the retained network and complete explicit future configuration. Read the original solver status, cost, selected catchments and calendar, alongside target-specific future counts. If infeasible, retain the actual result and make an explicit revised selection/configuration; do not disguise it as a successful calendar.

Operate the current application at desktop and390px, personally inspect both views, and use source selection, target edits, preview/save, saved history, design, report/export and fresh reopening. Open every generated HTML/CSV/JSON/source attachment and the full exported archive. Resolve actual visible errors in this same source. Preserve all existing scientific runs, the actual equipped receiving owner and the current AGENTS.md / CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md instructions. Warm correspondence remains with its original owner and Bryce's exact-message authorization.

Return the real runtime/source paths, exact saved context/proposal/design IDs, current source head, native result and actual rendered files to ECO-SAMPLING-15227-20261013 in the original Eco thread. Source construction and a retained Git blob alone are not a claim that this native course ran.

## One complete same-operation native course

The maintained source_tools/receive_sampling_recommendations.py accepts the exact authored inputs, executes the existing solver, exports the source-bound report and selected Study, restores it through model.portable.resume_restore and independently reopens the same complete proposal/design. It then recovers the original save operation from the immutable records in that fresh Workspace. Its output is outside the live Workspace and exact input files are preserved before work.

    GIS_PYTHON source_tools/receive_sampling_recommendations.py --workspace WORKSPACE --selection SELECTION.json --successor-selection SUCCESSOR.json --design-configuration NATIVE_CONFIGURATION.json --operation-id ECO-SAMPLING-15227-COURSE --output NEW_OPERATION_DIRECTORY

The successor input is optional; all other arguments select the real existing source and explicit planning intent. An infeasible native result remains an actual result. This command creates no historical observations, sends no message and starts no replacement server. Complete GUI and attachment operation follows in the same received application.

"""Typed Monitoring study dependencies for the original editable archive.

Original Workspace records, campaign replay identities and source objects stay
authoritative. Selection composes model.study_transfer; it creates no parallel
store, fieldwork scheduler or archive format.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy

from .common import canonical, digest, identifier, read_json

ROOT_KINDS = ("monitoring_networks", "monitoring_plans", "monitoring_frontiers",
              "monitoring_heads", "monitoring_observed_contexts",
              "monitoring_frontier_comparisons", "monitoring_recommendations",
              "monitoring_recommendation_designs")
IMMUTABLE_KINDS = ("monitoring_networks", "monitoring_plans", "monitoring_frontiers",
                   "monitoring_revisions", "monitoring_events",
                   "monitoring_observed_contexts", "monitoring_frontier_comparisons",
                   "monitoring_recommendations", "monitoring_recommendation_designs")
MUTABLE_KINDS = ("monitoring_heads", "monitoring_frontier_jobs")
DOCUMENTS = {"monitoring-report-sources": "report.json"}
LABELS = {
    "monitoring_networks": "Monitoring networks",
    "monitoring_plans": "Monitoring designs",
    "monitoring_frontiers": "Monitoring budget frontiers",
    "monitoring_frontier_comparisons": "Saved Monitoring budget choices",
    "monitoring_recommendations": "Sampling priorities and proposal history",
    "monitoring_recommendation_designs": "Sampling priority native designs",
    "monitoring_heads": "Editable monitoring campaigns",
    "monitoring_revisions": "Monitoring campaign revisions",
    "monitoring_events": "Monitoring field events",
    "monitoring_observed_contexts": "Monitoring observational context",
    "monitoring_frontier_jobs": "Monitoring budget continuation",
    "monitoring-report-sources": "Monitoring report sources",
}


def _native(closure, kind, key):
    """Read and hash an original immutable record, without changing Workspace."""
    key = identifier(key)
    value = closure.read(kind + "/" + key + ".json")
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate." + kind + "/v1" or digest(value) != key:
        raise ValueError("The original Monitoring record changed: " + kind + "/" + key)
    return {**value, "id": key}


def _binding(closure, binding, reason):
    if not isinstance(binding, dict):
        raise ValueError("Monitoring needs its original source binding.")
    key = binding.get("source_collection_id") or binding.get("source_record_id")
    closure.need("sources", key, reason)
    from .monitoring_sources import verify_retained_binding
    verify_retained_binding(closure.workspace, binding)


def _bindings(closure, bindings, reason):
    if not isinstance(bindings, dict):
        raise ValueError("Monitoring source bindings must retain their original mapping.")
    for binding in bindings.values():
        if binding:
            _binding(closure, binding, reason)


def _plan_network(closure, value, reason):
    plan = _native(closure, "monitoring_plans", value["plan_id"])
    if plan["network_id"] != value["network_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Monitoring history points to a different source network.")
    closure.need("monitoring_plans", plan["id"], reason)
    closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
    return plan


def _campaign(closure, key, head):
    if (head.get("campaign_id") != key or not isinstance(head.get("operations"), dict)):
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring campaign head changed its original identity.")
    identifier(head.get("revision_id"))
    seen, records = set(), []
    current = head["revision_id"]
    expected_number = None
    while current is not None:
        if current in seen:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring campaign history contains a revision cycle.")
        seen.add(current)
        revision = _native(closure, "monitoring_revisions", current)
        number = revision.get("revision")
        if (revision.get("campaign_id") != key or type(number) is not int or number < 1
                or (expected_number is not None and number != expected_number)):
            raise ValueError("Monitoring campaign history changed its revision sequence.")
        closure.need("monitoring_revisions", current, "Complete selected campaign history")
        records.append(revision)
        expected_number = number - 1
        current = revision.get("parent_id")
        if current is None and number != 1:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring campaign history lost its first revision.")
    if digest({"monitoring_campaign_creation": records[-1].get("operation_id")}) != key:
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring campaign changed its original creation operation.")
    by_id = {record["id"]: record for record in records}
    for operation_id, operation in head["operations"].items():
        if (not isinstance(operation_id, str) or not operation_id
                or not isinstance(operation, dict)
                or set(operation) != {"fingerprint", "revision_id"}):
            raise ValueError("The original campaign replay operation is unreadable.")
        identifier(operation["fingerprint"])
        record = by_id.get(operation["revision_id"])
        if record is None or record.get("operation_id") != operation_id:
            raise ValueError("Campaign replay no longer names its original revision.")
    for record in records:
        operation = head["operations"].get(record.get("operation_id"))
        if not operation or operation["revision_id"] != record["id"]:
            raise ValueError("Campaign history lost an original replay identity.")
    closure.monitoring_records[("monitoring_heads", key)] = {
        "kind": "monitoring_heads", "id": key, "head": copy.deepcopy(head),
        "revisions": [record["id"] for record in reversed(records)],
    }
    closure.nodes[("monitoring_heads", key)].update(
        title=records[0].get("title") or key[:12], state="saved",
        revisions=len(records), revision_id=head["revision_id"])


def _frontier_job(closure, key, head):
    if (head.get("job_id") != key or not isinstance(head.get("completed"), dict)):
        raise ValueError("Monitoring budget continuation changed its original identity.")
    for budget, plan_id in head["completed"].items():
        if (not isinstance(budget, str) or not budget.isdecimal()
                or str(int(budget)) != budget):
            raise ValueError("Monitoring budget continuation needs an exact original budget.")
        plan = _native(closure, "monitoring_plans", plan_id)
        if plan.get("frontier_job_id") != key or plan.get("frontier_budget_cents") != int(budget):
            raise ValueError("Monitoring budget continuation points to another saved design.")
        closure.need("monitoring_plans", plan_id, "Retained budget-comparison continuation")
    closure.monitoring_records[("monitoring_frontier_jobs", key)] = {
        "kind": "monitoring_frontier_jobs", "id": key, "head": copy.deepcopy(head),
    }


def _inspect_report(closure, key, value):
    """Keep native verification while admitting its exact source-view hardlinks.

    The original producer verifies its retained recipe by materializing source
    views. A cold restored Workspace has none. Only those declared CAS inodes
    may change ctime here, and their original bytes and stable identity must
    match before and after that owned operation.
    """
    from .common import file_digest
    from .monitoring_report_source import inspect
    from .study_transfer import _identity, _member, _stable_data_identity

    choice = value["source"]
    collection = _native(closure, "sources", choice["source_collection_id"])
    entries = [entry for entry in collection["entries"] if entry["id"] == choice["source_id"]]
    if len(entries) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring report lost its exact original source entry.")
    entry = entries[0]
    declared = {}
    for descriptor in [entry["body"]] + entry.get("companions", []):
        path = _member(closure.root, descriptor["object"])
        before = _identity(path)
        checksum = identifier(descriptor["sha256"])
        if before[2] != descriptor["bytes"] or file_digest(path) != checksum or _identity(path) != before:
            raise ValueError("The original Monitoring report source changed before verification.")
        token = before[:2]
        previous = declared.get(token)
        if previous is not None and previous["sha256"] != checksum:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring report source references disagree about one original inode.")
        declared[token] = {"identity": before, "sha256": checksum,
                           "links": path.stat().st_nlink}
    retained = {}
    for relative, item in closure.files.items():
        original = declared.get(item["identity"][:2])
        if original is None:
            continue
        path = _member(closure.root, relative)
        if (_identity(path) != item["identity"]
                or _stable_data_identity(item["identity"]) != _stable_data_identity(original["identity"])
                or item.get("sha256", original["sha256"]) != original["sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring source changed before native verification.")
        retained[relative] = original

    record = inspect(closure.workspace, key, verify=True)
    for relative, original in retained.items():
        path = _member(closure.root, relative)
        after = _identity(path)
        before = closure.files[relative]["identity"]
        if after == before:
            continue
        if (_stable_data_identity(after) != _stable_data_identity(before)
                or path.stat().st_nlink <= original["links"]
                or file_digest(path) != original["sha256"]
                or _identity(path) != after):
            raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring source changed during native verification.")
        closure.files[relative]["identity"] = after
        closure.files[relative]["sha256"] = original["sha256"]
    return record


def _report(closure, key, value):
    record = _inspect_report(closure, key, value)
    if record != value or record.get("state") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("Select a completed original Monitoring report source.")
    selection = record["selection"]
    if selection.get("plan_id"):
        closure.need("monitoring_plans", selection["plan_id"], "Saved Monitoring report design")
    if selection.get("campaign_id"):
        closure.need("monitoring_heads", selection["campaign_id"], "Editable reported Monitoring campaign")
        closure.need("monitoring_revisions", selection["expected_revision_id"],
                     "Exact reported Monitoring campaign revision")
    prefix = "monitoring-report-sources/" + key
    closure.tree(prefix)
    closure._descriptors(record["files"])
    closure._source_refs(record["source"], "Retained original Monitoring report source")
    if selection.get("comparison_id"):
        comparison_id = identifier(selection["comparison_id"])
        comparison = _native(closure, "monitoring_frontier_comparisons", comparison_id)
        expected = {
            "comparison_id": comparison_id,
            "frontier_id": comparison["frontier_id"],
            "network_id": comparison["network_id"],
            "plan_ids": comparison["plan_ids"],
            "context_ids": comparison["selection"]["context_ids"],
        }
        if closure.read(prefix + "/comparison-records.json") != expected:
            raise ValueError("The Monitoring report changed its exact saved budget choices.")
        closure.need("monitoring_frontier_comparisons", comparison_id,
                     "Editable original budget comparison behind the retained report")
    else:
        for row in closure.read(prefix + "/history-records.json"):
            kind = {"plans": "monitoring_plans", "networks": "monitoring_networks",
                    "revisions": "monitoring_revisions", "events": "monitoring_events"}.get(row.get("kind"))
            if kind is None:
                raise ValueError("A Monitoring report has an unknown original history kind.")
            closure.need(kind, row["id"], "Original reported Monitoring history")
    closure.monitoring_reports[key] = {
        "id": key, "record_sha256": record["record_sha256"],
        "source": copy.deepcopy(record["source"]),
    }


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    """Follow one explicitly ordered original Monitoring report source.

    Scientific report edition transfer calls this for its actual chosen source.
    Foreign project reports keep their contained CAS and original provenance;
    local producer identities must resolve to their complete editable history.
    """
    from . import observed_context
    if (entry.get("id") != "monitoring-design-and-field-history"
            or entry.get("role") != "monitoring-report-source"):
        return False
    recipe = closure.read(entry["body"]["object"])
    if (recipe.get("schema") != observed_context.SCHEMA
            or recipe.get("report_context_kind") not in {
                "monitoring-design-and-field-history", "monitoring-budget-comparison"}):
        raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring report lost its original recipe contract.")
    project_id = recipe.get("project_id")
    if not isinstance(project_id, str) or not project_id:
        raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring report lost its declared original project.")
    prefix = "urn:upstate:monitoring-report:" + project_id + ":"
    uri = entry.get("uri")
    if not isinstance(uri, str) or not uri.startswith(prefix):
        raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring report changed its original producer identity.")
    key = identifier(uri[len(prefix):])
    if project_id != closure.workspace.project["id"]:
        return False
    path = "monitoring-report-sources/" + key + "/report.json"
    report = closure.read(path)
    expected = {"source_collection_id": identifier(collection_id), "source_id": entry["id"]}
    if report.get("source") != expected:
        raise ValueError("The local Monitoring producer names another original source edition.")
    expected_kind = ("monitoring-budget-comparison" if report.get("selection", {}).get("comparison_id")
                     else "monitoring-design-and-field-history")
    if recipe["report_context_kind"] != expected_kind:
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring source recipe differs from its native report selection.")
    closure.need("monitoring-report-sources", key,
                 "Editable history of the explicitly ordered Monitoring report")
    return True


def _field_return(closure, event):
    """Retain the exact saved fieldwork source behind an original returned event."""
    binding = event.get("values", {}).get("fieldwork_return")
    if binding is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(binding, dict):
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring event lost its original fieldwork return binding.")
    key = identifier(binding.get("request_id"))
    prefix = "monitoring_field_returns/" + key
    # Reuse original request/plan validation within this single closure, while
    # validating every event and retaining the first full file identities.
    cache = getattr(closure, "_monitoring_field_return_cache", None)
    if cache is None:
        cache = {}
        closure._monitoring_field_return_cache = cache
    if (str(closure.workspace.root), key) not in cache:
        for name in ("request.json", "field-plan.json"):
            closure.read(prefix + "/" + name)
    from .monitoring_field_return import source_binding
    retained = source_binding(closure.workspace, event, cache=cache)
    if retained is None or retained["request_id"] != key:
        raise ValueError("The original fieldwork return resolved to another request.")
    expected = {name: str(closure.root / prefix / name)
                for name in ("request.json", "field-plan.json")}
    if retained["source_files"] != expected:
        raise ValueError("The original fieldwork return names another source directory.")
    selection = retained["request"]["selection"]
    closure.need("monitoring_revisions", selection["expected_revision_id"],
                 "Campaign revision reviewed for the original fieldwork return")


def _comparison(closure, key, value):
    """Reopen the original saved choice, preserving its exact immutable inputs."""
    from .monitoring_frontier_comparison import inspect
    inspected = inspect(closure.workspace, key)
    if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
        raise ValueError("The saved Monitoring budget comparison changed while selected.")
    selection = value["selection"]
    if (selection["frontier_id"] != value["frontier_id"]
            or selection["baseline_plan_id"] != value["baseline_plan_id"]
            or value["baseline_plan_id"] not in value["plan_ids"]):
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring comparison changed its retained baseline choice.")
    closure.need("monitoring_frontiers", value["frontier_id"],
                 "Original completed budget frontier of the saved comparison")
    closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"],
                 "Original source network of the saved budget comparison")
    for plan_id in value["plan_ids"]:
        closure.need("monitoring_plans", plan_id, "Original compared Monitoring design")
    for context_id in selection["context_ids"]:
        closure.need("monitoring_observed_contexts", context_id,
                     "Exact per-plan observed context of the saved budget comparison")


def _recommendation(closure, kind, key, value):
    """Carry original observations, ancestry and solver results in one study.

    Operation indices are a local derived cache. Immutable request identities
    travel with the selected records and rebuild that cache on an exact retry.
    """
    from . import monitoring_recommendations as recommendations

    reason = "Original source-bound sampling priorities"
    if kind == "monitoring_recommendations":
        inspected = recommendations.inspect(closure.workspace, key)
        if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
            raise ValueError("The sampling proposal changed while selected.")
        closure.need("monitoring_observed_contexts", value["context_id"], reason)
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        closure.need("sources", value["source_binding"]["source_collection_id"], reason)
        if any("model_evidence" in row for row in value.get("targets", [])):
            from . import monitoring_native_evidence
            monitoring_native_evidence.include(closure, value)
        revision = value.get("revision")
        if type(revision) is not int or revision < 1:
            raise ValueError("The sampling proposal lost its original revision number.")
        parent_id = value.get("parent_id")
        if parent_id:
            parent = _native(closure, kind, parent_id)
            if (parent.get("context_id") != value["context_id"]
                    or type(parent.get("revision")) is not int
                    or parent["revision"] + 1 != revision):
                raise ValueError("The sampling proposal changed its original ancestry.")
            closure.need(kind, parent_id, "Complete selected sampling proposal history")
        elif revision != 1:
            raise ValueError("The sampling proposal lost its first edition.")
        closure.nodes[(kind, key)].update(
            state="saved", revision=revision, context_id=value["context_id"])
    else:
        inspected = recommendations.inspect_design(closure.workspace, key)
        if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
            raise ValueError("The sampling design handoff changed while selected.")
        closure.need("monitoring_recommendations", value["recommendation_id"], reason)
        closure.need("monitoring_observed_contexts", value["context_id"], reason)
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)

    if kind == "monitoring_frontier_jobs":

        return True
    if kind == "monitoring-report-sources":

    if value.get("schema") != "upstate." + kind + "/v1" or digest(value) != key:

    if kind in {"monitoring_recommendations", "monitoring_recommendation_designs"}:

            closure.need("monitoring_recommendations", recommendation["id"],

        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        _bindings(closure, value["source_bindings"], reason)
        job_id = value.get("frontier_job_id")

    elif kind == "monitoring_frontiers":

        for plan_id in value["plan_ids"]:

                raise ValueError("Monitoring comparison mixes different original budget programmes.")

    elif kind == "monitoring_revisions":

        parent = value.get("parent_id")
        if parent:

            if (previous["campaign_id"] != value["campaign_id"]
                    or previous["revision"] + 1 != value["revision"]
                    or not set(previous["event_ids"]).issubset(value["event_ids"])):
                raise ValueError("Monitoring revision changed its retained parent or field history.")
            closure.need("monitoring_revisions", parent, reason)
        elif value.get("revision") != 1:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring revision lost its original parent.")
        for event_id in value["event_ids"]:
            event = _native(closure, "monitoring_events", event_id)
            if event["campaign_id"] != value["campaign_id"]:
                raise ValueError("Monitoring revision contains another campaign's field event.")
            closure.need("monitoring_events", event_id, reason)
    elif kind == "monitoring_events":
        _plan_network(closure, value, reason)
        _bindings(closure, value["source_bindings"], reason)
        _field_return(closure, value)
        if value.get("expected_revision_id"):
            closure.need("monitoring_revisions", value["expected_revision_id"],
                         "Original field-event campaign revision")
    elif kind == "monitoring_observed_contexts":
        from .monitoring_observed_context import inspect
        inspected = inspect(closure.workspace, key)
        if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
            raise ValueError("The observed Monitoring context changed while selected.")
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        closure.need("sources", value["source_binding"]["source_collection_id"], reason)
        native_binding = value.get("native_observation_binding")
        if native_binding and native_binding.get("project_id") == closure.workspace.project["id"]:
            from .monitoring_native_observations import verify_binding
            verify_binding(closure.workspace, native_binding)
            closure.need("observations", native_binding["observation_id"], reason)

            closure.need("monitoring_plans", value["plan_id"], reason)

            closure.need("monitoring_revisions", value["campaign_revision_id"], reason)

def verify_receipt(closure, captured):
    if captured is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(captured, dict) or set(captured) != {"campaigns", "frontiers", "reports"}:
        raise ValueError("The transferred Monitoring history has an unreadable identity.")
    for row in captured["campaigns"]:
        current = closure.monitoring_records.get(("monitoring_heads", row["id"]))
        if current is None:
            raise ValueError("The received study lost its editable Monitoring campaign.")
        before, after = row["head"], current["head"]
        if ({k: v for k, v in before.items() if k not in {"revision_id", "operations"}}
                != {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k not in {"revision_id", "operations"}}):
            raise ValueError("The received campaign changed its original identity.")
        if current["revisions"][:len(row["revisions"])] != row["revisions"]:
            raise ValueError("The received campaign replaced its retained history.")
        for operation_id, operation in before["operations"].items():
            if after["operations"].get(operation_id) != operation:
                raise ValueError("The received campaign changed an original replay operation.")
    for row in captured["frontiers"]:
        current = closure.monitoring_records.get(("monitoring_frontier_jobs", row["id"]))
        if current is None:
            raise ValueError("The received study lost its budget-comparison continuation.")
        before, after = row["head"], current["head"]
        if ({k: v for k, v in before.items() if k != "completed"}
                != {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k != "completed"}):
            raise ValueError("The received budget comparison changed its original identity.")
        if any(after["completed"].get(key) != value for key, value in before["completed"].items()):
            raise ValueError("The received budget comparison replaced a completed original design.")
    for row in captured["reports"]:
        if closure.monitoring_reports.get(row["id"]) != row:
            raise ValueError("The received Monitoring report source changed.")
    return {"campaigns": len(captured["campaigns"]), "frontiers": len(captured["frontiers"]),
            "reports": len(captured["reports"]), "identity": "MATCH"}


def catalogue(workspace, kind):
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        raise ValueError("Choose an original Monitoring study kind.")
    rows = []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / kind).glob("*.json")):
        key = path.stem
        try:
            identifier(key)
            value = read_json(path)
            if kind == "monitoring_heads":
                if value.get("campaign_id") != key:
                    raise ValueError("The campaign head has a different original identity.")
                record = workspace._get("monitoring_revisions", value["revision_id"])
                title, state = record.get("title"), "saved"
                selection = {"campaign_id": key, "revision_id": record["id"],
                             "plan_id": record["plan_id"], "network_id": record["network_id"]}
            else:
                record = workspace._get(kind, key)
                title, state = record.get("title"), record.get("status") or "saved"
                selection = {name: record[name] for name in
                             ("network_id", "plan_id", "campaign_id", "campaign_revision_id",
                              "frontier_id", "baseline_plan_id", "context_id", "recommendation_id") if record.get(name)}
            row = {"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": title or key[:12], "state": state,
                   "updated_at": record.get("created_at") or "", "selection": selection}
        except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, TypeError) as error:
            row = {"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": key[:12], "state": "unreadable",
                   "updated_at": "", "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}}
        rows.append(row)
    return rows

def original(path):
    body = Path(path).read_bytes()
    return {"filename": Path(path).name, "bytes": len(body),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
            "text": body.decode("utf-8")}



def _report_members(workspace, recommendation_id):
    return recommendations.export_members(workspace, recommendation_id)


def _member_inventory(files):
    return [{"path": name, "bytes": member["bytes"], "sha256": member["sha256"]}
            for name, member in sorted(files.items())]


def _evidence_roster(history):
    rows = []
    for proposal in history:
        for target in proposal["targets"]:
            evidence = target.get("model_evidence")
            if evidence is None:
                continue
            native, source = evidence["native"], evidence["source"]
            rows.append({"recommendation_id": proposal["id"], "target_id": target["target_id"],
                "selection": evidence["selection"], "source": source,
                "native_family": native["family"], "native_id": native["id"],
                "native_project_id": native["project_id"],
                "run_ids": native["run_ids"], "selected_quantity": native["selected_quantity"],
                "support": native["support"], "target_binding": evidence["target_binding"],
                "relation": evidence["relation"]})
    return rows


def _required_nodes(project_id, roster):
    nodes = set()
    for row in roster:
        source = row["source"]
        nodes.add(("sources", source["collection_id"]))
        if row["native_project_id"] == project_id:
            kinds = {"control_outcomes": "multivariate-control-outcomes",
                     "terrain_response": "terrain-conditioning-report-sources",
                     "conservation_portfolio": "conservation-report-sources"}
            if row["native_family"] not in kinds:
                raise ValueError("Choose a supported retained Sampling native evidence family")
            kind = kinds[row["native_family"]]
            nodes.add((kind, row["native_id"]))
            for run_id in row["run_ids"]:
                nodes.add(("runs", run_id))
    return [{"kind": kind, "id": key} for kind, key in sorted(nodes)]


def _extract_report(archive_path, destination, files):
    """Open every exact packet member and retain ordinary reviewable files."""
    import os
    import shutil
    import tempfile
    import zipfile
    from model.monitoring_packet import _member_name, _verify_existing
    from model.common import file_digest
    archive_path, destination = Path(archive_path), Path(destination)
    _verify_existing(archive_path, files)
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    root = destination.resolve()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        for name, member in sorted(files.items()):
            _member_name(name)
            target = destination / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("The report member left its retained receiving directory")
            if target.exists():
                if target.stat().st_size != member["bytes"] or file_digest(target) != member["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("Preserve the existing reviewed report file: " + name)
                continue
            temporary = None
            try:
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=target.parent, prefix=".receiving-", delete=False) as outgoing:
                    temporary = Path(outgoing.name)
                    with archive.open(name) as incoming:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(incoming, outgoing, length=1024 * 1024)
                    outgoing.flush()
                    os.fsync(outgoing.fileno())
                if temporary.stat().st_size != member["bytes"] or file_digest(temporary) != member["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("The extracted original report member differs: " + name)
                os.replace(temporary, target)
                temporary = None
            finally:
                if temporary is not None:
                    temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return str(destination / "sampling-review.html")


def _verify_evidence_received(workspace, expected):
    """Execute from the received application, following original saved records."""
    if workspace.project != expected["project"]:
        raise ValueError("The received evidence belongs to another original project")
    proposal = recommendations.inspect(workspace, expected["proposal"]["id"])
    design = recommendations.inspect_design(workspace, expected["design"]["id"])
    history = recommendations.history(workspace, proposal["id"])
    if (proposal != expected["proposal"] or design != expected["design"]
            or history != expected["history"]):
        raise ValueError("The received proposal, native plan or complete original history differs")
    roster = _evidence_roster(history)
    if roster != expected["native_evidence"]:
        raise ValueError("The received source, quantity, support or target binding changed")
    # This also validates raw CAS and every selected local native dependency
    # through the unchanged original proposal and producer inspection methods.
    inventory = _member_inventory(_report_members(workspace, proposal["id"]))
    if inventory != expected["report_members"]:
        raise ValueError("Cold receiving changed the original report, CSV, source or companion bytes")
    from model import study_transfer as original_studies
    original_studies.verify_received_studies(workspace)
    return {"schema": "upstate.sampling-native-evidence-cold-receiving/v1",
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "proposal_id": proposal["id"],
        "design_id": design["id"], "plan_id": design["plan_id"],
        "history_ids": [r["id"] for r in history], "native_evidence": roster,
        "report_member_count": len(inventory),
        "proposal_history_equal": True, "native_records_equal": True,
        "report_member_bytes_equal": True, "rendered_inspection": False}

def _receive_evidence(workspace, parent, configuration, args):
    """Continue the same original course with an explicitly authored child.

    The first course's sealed proposal, report and Study archive remain intact.
    A later explicit child may remove evidence while retaining its full ancestry.
    """
    import subprocess
    from model.common import file_digest, held
    from model.monitoring_packet import _verify_existing
    output = args.output.resolve() / "native-evidence"
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(output / ".course.lock", blocking=False):
        inputs = {"schema": "upstate.sampling-native-evidence-course-input/v1",
            "operation_id": args.operation_id, "project": workspace.project,
            "parent_id": parent["id"], "selection": original(args.evidence_selection),
            "successor_selection": original(args.evidence_successor_selection) if args.evidence_successor_selection else None,
            "design_configuration": original(args.evidence_design_configuration) if args.evidence_design_configuration else None,
            "original_design_configuration": configuration}
        retain(output / "original-evidence-inputs.json", inputs)
        selection = json.loads(inputs["selection"]["text"])
        if not any("model_evidence" in row for row in selection.get("targets", [])):
            raise ValueError("The authored evidence phase needs at least one explicit native source/quantity")
        preview = recommendations.preview(workspace, selection=selection)
        retain(output / "proposal-preview.json", preview)
        child = recommendations.prepare(workspace, selection=selection,
            operation_id=args.operation_id + "-native-evidence-proposal",
            parent_id=parent["id"], expected_parent_digest=parent["id"])
        repeated = recommendations.prepare(workspace, selection=selection,
            operation_id=args.operation_id + "-native-evidence-proposal",
            parent_id=parent["id"], expected_parent_digest=parent["id"])
        if child != repeated:
            raise ValueError("The evidence child retry changed the original immutable request")
        retain(output / "evidence-proposal.json", child)
        selected = child
        if inputs["successor_selection"]:
            successor = json.loads(inputs["successor_selection"]["text"])
            selected = recommendations.prepare(workspace, selection=successor,
                operation_id=args.operation_id + "-native-evidence-successor",
                parent_id=child["id"], expected_parent_digest=child["id"])
            if recommendations.prepare(workspace, selection=successor,
                    operation_id=args.operation_id + "-native-evidence-successor",
                    parent_id=child["id"], expected_parent_digest=child["id"]) != selected:
                raise ValueError("The evidence successor retry changed its original request")
            retain(output / "evidence-successor.json", selected)
        config = (json.loads(inputs["design_configuration"]["text"])
                  if inputs["design_configuration"] else configuration)
        design = recommendations.design(workspace, recommendation_id=selected["id"],
            configuration=config, operation_id=args.operation_id + "-native-evidence-design")
        if recommendations.inspect_design(workspace, design["id"]) != design:
            raise ValueError("The evidence proposal's original Monitoring design changed")
        retain(output / "native-design.json", design)
        history = recommendations.history(workspace, selected["id"])
        roster = _evidence_roster(history)
        if not roster:
            raise ValueError("The retained full proposal history lost its native evidence")
        files = _report_members(workspace, selected["id"])
        export_path = output / "report-export.json"
        if export_path.exists():
            exported = read_json(export_path)
            if exported.get("recommendation_id") != selected["id"]:
                raise ValueError("This saved report belongs to another selected proposal")
        else:
            exported = recommendations.export_recommendations(workspace,
                recommendation_id=selected["id"], export_root=output / "reports")
            retain(export_path, exported)
        actual = _verify_existing(Path(exported["path"]), files)
        if actual["bytes"] != exported["bytes"] or actual["sha256"] != exported["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The complete native-evidence report packet changed")
        report_html = _extract_report(exported["path"], output / "report-files", files)
        expected = {"schema": "upstate.sampling-native-evidence-receiving-expectation/v1",
            "project": workspace.project, "proposal": selected, "design": design,
            "history": history, "native_evidence": roster,
            "report_members": _member_inventory(files)}
        expected_path = output / "receiving-expectation.json"
        retain(expected_path, expected)
        selection_transfer = {"title": selected["title"],
            "roots": [{"kind": "monitoring_recommendations", "id": selected["id"]},
                      {"kind": "monitoring_recommendation_designs", "id": design["id"]}],
            "include_related_results": True}
        retain(output / "study-selection.json", selection_transfer)
        archive = output / "sampling-native-evidence-editable-study.zip"
        transfer = study_transfer.export_study(workspace, archive, selection_transfer)
        transfer = {k: v for k, v in transfer.items() if k != "reused_completed_output"}
        retain(output / "study-export.json", transfer)
        included = {(r["kind"], r["id"]) for r in transfer["study"]["identity"]["nodes"]}
        required = _required_nodes(workspace.project["id"], roster)
        if any((r["kind"], r["id"]) not in included for r in required):
            raise ValueError("The selected Study lost an exact native evidence source or local case")
        received_root = output / "received-study"
        archive_sha256 = file_digest(archive)
        restored = (portable.resume_restore(archive, received_root,
            expected_archive_sha256=archive_sha256) if received_root.exists()
            else portable.restore(archive, received_root))
        received = Workspace(restored["workspace"])
        reopened = _verify_evidence_received(received, expected)
        # The original operation-index recovery follows immutable records, and
        # does not create another proposal or native solver result.
        raw = selected["request_payload"]
        if recommendations.prepare(received, selection=raw["selection"],
                operation_id=selected["operation_id"], parent_id=raw["parent_id"],
                expected_parent_digest=raw["expected_parent_digest"]) != selected:
            raise ValueError("Cold evidence receiving changed its retained operation identity")
        application = Path(restored["application"])
        receiver = application / "source_tools" / Path(__file__).name
        if not receiver.is_file():
            raise ValueError("The complete received application needs its original Sampling receiver")
        cold_path = output / "contained-application-reopen.json"
        process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(receiver), "--verify-evidence-received",
            "--workspace", str(received.root), "--expected", str(expected_path),
            "--output", str(cold_path)], cwd=application, text=True, capture_output=True)
        (output / "contained-application-stdout.txt").write_text(process.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
        (output / "contained-application-stderr.txt").write_text(process.stderr, encoding="utf-8")
        if process.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError("The original contained Sampling receiver failed: " + process.stderr[-12000:])
        cold = read_json(cold_path)
        if {k: v for k, v in cold.items() if k != "application"} != reopened:
            raise ValueError("The contained application reopened different original evidence")
        result = {"schema": "upstate.sampling-native-evidence-course/v1",
            "operation_id": args.operation_id, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
            "parent_id": parent["id"], "first_evidence_proposal_id": child["id"],
            "proposal_id": selected["id"], "design_id": design["id"], "plan_id": design["plan_id"],
            "history_ids": [r["id"] for r in history], "native_evidence": roster,
            "required_native_nodes": required, "report": exported, "report_html": report_html,
            "report_member_count": len(files), "study": transfer,
            "received_application": str(application), "received_workspace": str(received.root),
            "contained_reopen": str(cold_path), "operation_recovery_equal": True,
            "rendered_inspection": False,
            "browser_course": "Open the exact populated Sampling desk at desktop and390px, operate evidence choice, quantity and applicability, preview/save/reopen/revision/export/native calendar/Study. Open and LOOK at every original outgoing report, map, CSV/JSON and extracted archive member; record actual visual results separately."}
        retain(output / "sampling-native-evidence-result.json", result)
        return result

# Sampling working copies and exact saved designs

TokenJunkieLabs. This chapter extends the installed Sampling priorities workflow. Original observations, proposal calculations, Monitoring solver, saved plans and field calendars remain authoritative.

## Complete operator course

Open Sampling priorities and choose the original observed context. Open a saved proposal and, when present, choose one of its saved native designs. The exact original configuration and request are retained; opening the design runs no calculation.

Edit recommendation targets, rationale, explicit costs, calendar, budget and advanced configuration. An unfinished JSON field, empty rationale, zero and unknown/null values can be saved in a working file. The exact authored working state is distinct from a validated proposal and a calculated design.

Save the working copy through the existing operator queue. A revision points to its exact immutable parent and preserves the original input JSON, source binding, operator identity and request history. A changed observed context begins a new family. Retrying the same original operation recovers its immutable result; reusing that operation with different input is rejected.

Opening a downloaded JSON first previews its source bindings. The current Workspace must contain the same project and exact observed context, proposal and selected design. Their original model inspectors validate them; scientific results in an uploaded file are never accepted as replacements. The operator explicitly chooses when to adopt the draft.

The difference review compares authored inputs with the selected original proposal and design. It does not estimate a scientific outcome. Submit the original Prepare proposal and Design actions to calculate changed inputs. The existing original solver and all source/cost/calendar validation remain in force.

A pending or retained request carries its original workspace identity and exact payload. A matching workspace label alone cannot establish that a queue survived restoration. Opening, previewing, saving and exporting never dispatch a retained request. The existing operator must find and verify the actual original task before recovery; a foreign or missing task remains retained for explicit reconciliation. Later edits remain separate from an earlier outstanding request.

## Exact file contract

The editable file has schema `upstate.sampling-working-copy/v1` and these complete fields:

- `project_id`, `workspace_key`: original project and operator workspace identity.
- `context_id`, `context_digest`: exact retained observed context.
- `recommendation_id`, `recommendation_digest`, `design_id`, `design_digest`: selected original records or null pairs.
- `draft`, `design_draft`: complete current form state, including advanced JSON text and optional assembled authored configuration.
- `pending_request`, `retained_requests`: exact original kind, payload, operation ID, task ID, state and retained metadata.
- `filters`, `title`, `operator`, `notes`, and optional `editor_state`: current editing/navigation state.

The limit is 8 MiB of UTF-8 JSON. Duplicate fields and nonfinite numbers are rejected. Valid source identity is required even when the authored planning fields remain incomplete. All incomplete form values are retained, not normalized into a guessed scientific selection.

Queued actions extend the existing descriptor:

- `monitoring.recommendations.working-save`: payload `{working_file,parent_id,expected_parent_digest}`. For a revision both parent fields are the exact immutable parent ID; for a new family both are null.
- `monitoring.recommendations.working-export`: payload `{working_id,format}`, where format is `bundle` or `workspace`.

Reads use the existing authenticated route with actions working-list, working-get and working-preview. POST supports a complete working-preview body without placing the file in a query string. Preview produces no queue effects.

# Sampling priorities

Sampling priorities opens from the original operator navigation, immediately after Monitoring. It uses a saved observational context, explicit planning targets and the existing Monitoring design engine. The screen does not infer ecological sensitivity, replace censored measurements, create collected samples, or promise high-flow events.

## Open the original observations

1. Select the original Workspace.
2. Open **Sampling priorities**, then choose a **Saved observational context**.
3. Review the original station bindings, exact analytical cohorts, declared source period and retained context identity.
4. Use **Open original context in Monitoring** to inspect the saved network, original calendar and complete observational support.
5. Enter a historical evidence window, or click **Use the complete declared evidence window** to adopt the original source dates explicitly.

The analytical cohort retains each original characteristic, method, unit, fraction, result-value type, speciation and any additional source metadata used by the compiler. Missing, null and stated metadata remain distinct. A cohort present elsewhere in the original source can be selected for a station with no matching observations.

A month goal counts distinct historical sampling dates in that calendar month across the complete selected evidence window. It is not an annual quota. Replicate measurements do not manufacture additional sampling dates.

## Enter a justified proposal

Complete the recommendation title, responsible operator, recording time with timezone and planning basis. Add a target for each station/cohort requirement.

Each target records:

- An exact original source station and analytical cohort.
- The historical months to inspect and a distinct-date goal.
- A separately entered number of future visits.
- An optional proposed reporting limit in the original cohort unit, with its laboratory or scientific rationale.
- Any-flow or same-station high-flow coverage as an explicit objective.
- Priority, inclusion, station/season/analyte rationale and any operator-supplied sensitivity basis.
- Setup and per-visit costs in USD, with the cost basis.

Blank cost and reporting-limit fields remain unknown. Zero is an explicit value. The preview adds entered setup plus proposed visits times per-visit cost for included targets. It does not silently discount overlapping visits or substitute zero for unknown costs.

Sensitivity text is retained as the operator's rationale. No model information gain or ecological coefficient is calculated from it.

## Review gaps and original evidence

Choose **Preview gaps and costs**.

The review shows an itemized target summary, known entered programme cost, unknown-cost targets and a monthly gap table. Filter the monthly table by source station or unmet goals; these view filters do not change the saved targets or complete export.

Expand an individual target to inspect its rationale, reporting limits, unknown or incompatible limit units, eligible original high-flow episodes and complete observation fields, including original IDs, qualifiers and source locators. Original values remain unchanged.

High-flow support applies only where the retained source explicitly identifies the same station as eligible for the original flow series. An unrelated nearby gauge is not substituted. A calendar cannot ensure a future storm.

The handoff section shows exact required catchments, unbound targets and conflicting station bindings. Those assignments need resolution in the maintained network workflow before preparing a compatible native design.

## Save, revise and reopen

Choose **Save recommendation** to retain the complete selection, original context and calculated support.

Choose an existing entry under **Saved sampling edition**, then **Open saved edition** to reopen that exact source-bound result. Edit the targets and choose **Save new revision** to retain a new immutable child. The request carries the original parent ID as its expected parent identity. **Open original parent edition** returns to the retained preceding edition.

Refreshing the saved catalog does not discard an in-memory draft. Changing the selected context or opening another saved edition asks before replacing unsaved target or design edits. Navigating away and back in the same operator session preserves the Workspace's draft. Closing or reloading the browser warns about unsaved edits; only saved editions are durable Workspace records.

Recording time remains explicit when making a revision. Update it to the time the operator records the revised proposal.

## Prepare the existing Monitoring design

Open **Prepare an original Monitoring design from the saved edition**.

When the observed context refers to an original saved plan, its complete design configuration seeds this form. Otherwise the numeric planning fields remain blank and require explicit input. Review the native programme budget, maximum sites, overhead, setup and visit costs, cost basis, dates, round interval, crews, duration and travel allowance.

Additional original configuration remains visible as a JSON object. Unexposed fields and original default-cost/calendar metadata survive. The visible controls take precedence over their corresponding JSON values. Review cost provenance whenever changing the figures.

The exact required catchments shown from the saved recommendation are included in the submitted configuration. Extra required IDs may be retained through the additional configuration. Station bindings and laboratory/event-trigger requirements remain explicit.

Choose **Prepare Monitoring design**. This invokes the existing native solver with the complete reviewed configuration. Unknown itemized proposal costs do not become invented native costs: the native design still requires its own complete configuration.

Inspect the returned feasibility status and target/calendar comparison. Calendar visits are compared against the proposed visit counts in the chosen months. A feasible geographic design does not itself satisfy every analyte, reporting-limit or future high-flow objective.

Choose **Open design and field calendar** to open the exact saved plan in the original Monitoring component. Reopened sampling editions list their already-prepared designs as **Open saved design and calendar**. The Monitoring component retains responsibility for calendar and campaign preparation.

## Export and receive

**Export saved edition and original sources** prepares the original model's complete report/source package and exposes its authenticated file ticket. It exports the retained saved edition even if separate unsaved form edits exist.

**Export editable study** opens the existing Study transfer workflow with this exact saved recommendation as its selected root. Review the dependency closure and prepare the original study archive there. This is the editable Workspace transfer path; the report/source ZIP is a separate output.

The original context and original field values remain available in the complete export. View filters never reduce source attachments. Reopen or import through the maintained receiving workflow rather than reconstructing a saved recommendation from a summary table.

## Original queued operations

Prepare, design and report export run through the existing operator task queue. **Open retained operation** opens that exact task.

If the HTTP response is uncertain, **Resume original request** reuses the original operation ID and unchanged payload. It does not generate a second submission. If the task itself failed or was cancelled, inspect and resume it through the original task controls. The UI retains its request and draft.

Workspace changes and detached views invalidate outstanding display updates. A late response cannot replace another Workspace's current selection. Accepted work remains in its original Workspace and queue.

## Integration

The additive registry extension is monitoring-recommendations, titled Sampling priorities. The browser factory is attachMonitoringRecommendations and the sources are:

- operator/web/monitoring_recommendations.mjs
- operator/web/monitoring_recommendations.css
- operator/SAMPLING_PRIORITIES.md

The original extension host supplies getState, api, endpoint, showTask, toast and openDesk. No shared app or Monitoring component rewrite is required.

Reads use GET /api/monitoring-recommendations with workspace, action and a JSON payload. Actions are catalog, context, preview, get and list. Mutations use POST /api/actions with monitoring.recommendations.prepare, monitoring.recommendations.design or monitoring.recommendations.export, the original Workspace, complete payload and stable operation_id.

Saved design navigation calls monitoring.openStudy with kind monitoring_plans. Original context navigation uses monitoring_observed_contexts. Editable transfer calls study-transfer.openForStudies with the exact monitoring_recommendations root.

## Verification scope

The maintained browser module was executed with an explicit DOM and host-API adapter for context selection, target entry, preview, ambiguous-response retry, save, immutable revision, native design configuration, export and exact downstream navigation. The course checks zero versus unknown values, original unexposed configuration, source-bound required IDs and workspace-change rejection of stale responses.

This source/controller course is separate from a native Python execution or actual browser-pixel review. The accepting native host should operate the same installed extension with its actual saved context, inspect the report/source package, prepare a justified native design, export an editable study and reopen it through the original receiving route.

Carry the current application AGENTS.md (owner rule version 2026-10-13.1) and CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md (current read version 2026-10-13.4) into the same producing/receiving operation. Preserve subsequent direct owner instructions and the actual equipped operator's active processes and source choices.

Open and use every outgoing attachment, including the HTML report, CSV/JSON sources and editable archive after fresh receiving. Repair actual visible defects in the same source. Keep this inspection focused on the delivered workflow; source execution and API adapters do not substitute for the rendered product.
